title: GraphNode
description: One node in the Director Memory Graph (Cinematic Intelligence Layer, Phase 7) - the memory backbone future AI Directors query instead of re-reading raw project history. Embedded, no schema_version of its own (like camera.schema.json/motion.schema.json) - it only ever exists inside an IGraphStore.

ref_id.description: The character_id/object_id/environment_id/style_lock_id/event_id this node represents, for lookup in its owning profile store.

properties.description: Free-form key/value attributes copied onto the node for cheap graph queries without a join back to the profile store.
